zh.title: Dublin 和 Pleasanton 住哪里更合适？从一周的生活半径比较
zh.seo_title: Dublin与Pleasanton买房比较｜住房、通勤与生活｜陈靖
zh.description: Dublin 和 Pleasanton 住哪里更合适？比较两市的 BART 接驳、公园与市中心生活、学校地址查询和具体住房条件，从真实的一周安排判断适合自己的生活半径。
zh.lead: Dublin 与 Pleasanton 相邻，选房时容易被放在一起比较。更细致的判断，可以从一周安排开始：你怎样去车站，常去哪里活动，希望怎样使用室内外空间，以及愿意承担多少维护工作。

en.title: Dublin or Pleasanton? Compare the Radius of Your Week
en.seo_title: Dublin vs. Pleasanton: Homes and Commute | Jing Chen
en.description: Dublin or Pleasanton? Compare BART connections, parks and downtown life, school lookups and home conditions to find the daily radius that fits your week.
en.lead: Dublin and Pleasanton sit side by side, so they often get compared. Start with your week: how you reach the station, where you go, how you use your space indoors and out, and how much upkeep you want to take on.
